rationale_evidence.anchor: This is experimental, not final … Assessment with an authority field … defined and then unused
rationale_evidence.statement: AF-F-32's Commit-rule crossing (step 025a-2 §36, five conjuncts, no authority conjunct) is verified verbatim and sharpened: the same source, two sections earlier, defines an Assessment object with an authority field that is defined and then left unused in the Commit rule; §23 explicitly boxes 'Authenticity ≠ Authority' and §36 then fails to encode it; §37 admits authority only as an adjective on the observation ('one current authoritative direct observation') -- exactly the collapse Article 3.1 forbids. The finding stands scoped to the PROPOSED-OPEN corpus layer only, not the ratified/authorized surface (GN-29: archaeology outputs are historical evidence, never authority).
